Read the files of one run of Strong4VM

Source: R/read.R
vp_read.Rd

Read the results of one run of Strong4VM.

Usage

vp_read(
  prefix,
  name = NULL,
  artificial = c("keep", "drop"),
  translator = c("kmax", "kconfigreader"),
  form = c("complete", "minimal")
)

Arguments

prefix

The path of the files without their ending, e.g. "out/miband3_realized" (the part before "__").

name

A short name for the model, used in tables; by default the last part of the prefix.

artificial

What to do with nodes whose names look like helper variables of a translation ("k!12", "__VISIBILITY__X", ""): "keep" (default) or "drop". Strong4VM 2.0 already drops them; "drop" is for the graphs of version 1, such as those of the Zenodo dataset.

translator

With artificial = "drop": "kmax" (default) or "kconfigreader", whose formulas have two more kinds of helper variable: CHOICE_n (one per choice group) and X_MODULE ("X is built as a module", dropped only when X exists).

form

"complete" (default) reads the complete graphs; "minimal" reads the minimal form that Strong4VM writes beside them (__requires_skeleton.net, __excludes_primitive.net, __atleastone_primitive.net): see vp_minimal().

Value

A model: a list with the tibbles features, requires, excludes, atleastone (NULL when the run had no or_graph = TRUE) and atomic, plus variables and summary when the run wrote them.

See also

Other reading: vp_classify(), vp_example(), vp_expand(), vp_features(), vp_functions(), vp_generate(), vp_history(), vp_igraph(), vp_links(), vp_minimal(), vp_read_history(), vp_read_uvl_tree(), vp_representativeness(), vp_subset()

Examples

prefix <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3.uvl"), read = FALSE)
band <- vp_read(prefix)
band
#> variplex model "miband3"
#>   features: 11 variable (the nodes of the graphs), 8 core, 0 dead
#>   requires: 36 arrows   excludes: 18 lines
#>   at least one: not computed (use vp_generate(or_graph = TRUE))
#>   atomic sets: 2 (of two or more features)
vp_read(prefix, form = "minimal")
#> variplex model "miband3"
#>   features: 8 variable (the nodes of the graphs), 8 core, 0 dead
#>   requires: 6 arrows   excludes: 3 lines
#>   at least one: not computed (use vp_generate(or_graph = TRUE))
#>   minimal form: skeleton, primitive conflicts;
#>   each atomic set is one node (2 sets)
